namespace OffFive16ConnectedSingle
open Finset
abbrev Marks := OffFive16DisconnectedSingle.Marks
abbrev Label := Fin 16

def pin (P : List ℕ) (u : ℕ) : ℕ := P[u-11]?.getD 0

def dirPre (m : Marks) (P : List ℕ) (u v : Label) : Bool :=
  let a := u.val
  let b := v.val
  ((decide (b=a+1 ∧ b≤10) || decide (a=pin P b ∧ a≠0 ∧ 11≤b)) ||
    (if h : a=0 ∧ 1≤b ∧ b≤10 then decide (m ⟨b-1,by omega⟩=1) else false)) ||
    (if h : b=10 ∧ a<10 then decide (m ⟨a,h.2⟩=2) else false)

def edgePre (m : Marks) (P : List ℕ) (u v : Label) : Bool :=
  dirPre m P u v || dirPre m P v u

def endCode (m : Marks) (right : Bool) (k : ℕ) : Bool :=
  if h : 1≤k ∧ k≤9 then
    if right then decide (m ⟨k,by omega⟩=2)
    else decide (m ⟨k-1,by omega⟩=1)
  else false

def centerBoth (m : Marks) : Bool :=
  (List.range' 1 9).any (fun k => endCode m false k && endCode m true k)

def middle (m : Marks) (right : Bool) (k : Fin 9) : Bool :=
  !endCode m right (k.val+1) &&
    (endCode m right k.val || endCode m right (k.val+2))

def pathScore (m : Marks) (right : Bool) : ℕ :=
  ((univ : Finset (Fin 9)).filter (fun k => middle m right k=true)).card +
    (if centerBoth m then 1 else 0)

def porterScore (m : Marks) (right : Bool) (P : List ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ((univ : Finset (Fin 5)).filter (fun k => endCode m right (P[k.val]?.getD 0)=true)).card

def siteChoices (S : List ℕ) (k : ℕ) : List (Fin 3) :=
  [0] ++ (if k∈S then [] else [1]) ++ (if k+1∈S then [] else [2])

def wordsFor (S : List ℕ) : List ℕ→List (List (Fin 3))
  | [] => [[]]
  | k::K => (siteChoices S k).flatMap (fun c => (wordsFor S K).map (c::·))

theorem mem_wordsFor {S K : List ℕ} {m : ℕ→Fin 3}
    (ok : ∀ q∈K,m q∈siteChoices S q) : K.map m∈wordsFor S K := by
  induction K with
  | nil => simp [wordsFor]
  | cons k K ih =>
    apply List.mem_flatMap.mpr
    exact ⟨m k,ok k (by simp),List.mem_map.mpr ⟨K.map m,ih (fun q qm => ok q (by simp [qm])),rfl⟩⟩

def fitted (d : List (Fin 3)) : Marks :=
  OffFive16DisconnectedSingle.fromList ((1::d)++[2])

def count (m : Marks) (c : Fin 3) : ℕ :=
  ((univ : Finset (Fin 10)).filter (fun k => m k=c)).card

def markIndex : List ℕ := List.range' 1 8

def tuplesRaw (S : List ℕ) : ℕ→List (List ℕ)
  | 0 => [[]]
  | n+1 => (0::S).flatMap fun c => (tuplesRaw S n).map (c::·)

theorem mem_tuplesRaw {S : List ℕ} {P : List ℕ}
    (ok : ∀ k∈P,k=0 ∨ k∈S) : P∈tuplesRaw S P.length := by
  induction P with
  | nil => simp [tuplesRaw]
  | cons k P ih =>
    apply List.mem_flatMap.mpr
    refine ⟨k,by simpa using ok k (by simp),?_⟩
    exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨P,ih (fun e h => ok e (by simp [h])),rfl⟩

def tuples (S : List ℕ) : List (List ℕ) :=
  (tuplesRaw S 5).filter (fun P => decide (P.Pairwise (·≤·)) && S.all (fun k => decide (k∈P)))

theorem mem_tuples {S P : List ℕ}
    (len : P.length=5) (ok : ∀ k∈P,k=0 ∨ k∈S)
    (sorted : P.Pairwise (·≤·)) (full : ∀ k∈S,k∈P) :
    P∈tuples S := by
  have h : S.all (fun k => decide (k∈P))=true :=
    List.all_eq_true.mpr (fun k km => decide_eq_true (full k km))
  apply List.mem_filter.mpr
  refine ⟨?_,by simp [sorted,h]⟩
  rw [←len]
  exact mem_tuplesRaw ok

def matchPre (S P : List ℕ) (m : Marks) : Bool :=
  known.any fun q => decide (q.support=S ∧ q.ports=P ∧ q.signs=List.ofFn m)

def markGate (S : List ℕ) (d : List (Fin 3)) : Bool :=
  let m := fitted d
  if 4≤count m 1 ∧ 4≤count m 2 then
    let L := pathScore m false
    let R := pathScore m true
    if L≤4 ∧ R≤4 then
      (tuples S).all (fun P =>
        !(decide (L+porterScore m false P≤4 ∧ R+porterScore m true P≤4)) || matchPre S P m)
    else true
  else true

def preRow (S : List ℕ) : Bool := (wordsFor S markIndex).all (markGate S)

namespace OffFive16ConnectedSingle
open Finset

private theorem fitted_m (m : Marks) (h0 : m 0=1) (h9 : m 9=2) :
    fitted (markIndex.map (fun k => m (Fin.ofNat' 10 k)))=m := by
  funext k
  fin_cases k <;>
    norm_num [fitted,OffFive16DisconnectedSingle.fromList,markIndex,List.range',Fin.ofNat',h0,h9]
  all_goals first | rfl | exact h9.symm

theorem projected_match {S P : List ℕ} {m : Marks} (row : preRow S=true)
    (mp : P∈tuples S) (m0 : m 0=1) (m9 : m 9=2)
    (rot : ∀ k∈S,m (Fin.ofNat' 10 k)≠1 ∧ m (Fin.ofNat' 10 (k-1))≠2)
    (cl : 4≤count m 1) (cr : 4≤count m 2)
    (cap0 : pathScore m false+porterScore m false P≤4)
    (cap10 : pathScore m true+porterScore m true P≤4) :
    matchPre S P m=true := by
  let d := markIndex.map (fun k => m (Fin.ofNat' 10 k))
  have dm : d∈wordsFor S markIndex := by
    apply mem_wordsFor
    intro k _
    have h1 : k∈S → m (Fin.ofNat' 10 k)≠1 := fun ks => (rot k ks).1
    have h2 : k+1∈S → m (Fin.ofNat' 10 k)≠2 := by
      intro ks
      have rt := (rot (k+1) ks).2
      simpa using rt
    let c := m (Fin.ofNat' 10 k)
    change c∈siteChoices S k
    have trip (z : Fin 3) : z=0 ∨ z=1 ∨ z=2 := by fin_cases z <;> decide
    have alt := trip c
    rcases alt with cz|o|t
    · simp [siteChoices,cz]
    · have no : k∉S := fun ks => h1 ks o
      simp [siteChoices,o,no]
    · have no : k+1∉S := fun ks => h2 ks t
      simp [siteChoices,t,no]
  have gate := List.all_eq_true.mp row d dm
  have eq : fitted d=m := fitted_m m m0 m9
  have lo : pathScore m false≤4 := by omega
  have hi : pathScore m true≤4 := by omega
  have rr : (tuples S).all (fun P =>
      !(decide (pathScore m false+porterScore m false P≤4 ∧ pathScore m true+porterScore m true P≤4)) ||
      matchPre S P m)=true := by
    simpa [markGate,eq,cl,cr,lo,hi] using gate
  have h := List.all_eq_true.mp rr P mp
  simpa [cap0,cap10] using h

#print axioms projected_match
end OffFive16ConnectedSingle

def supportRows : List (List ℕ) := [[1,4],[1,5],[1,6],[1,7],[1,8],[1,9],[2,5],[2,6],[2,7],[2,8],[3,6],[3,7],[1,4,7],[1,4,8],[1,4,9],[1,5,8],[1,5,9],[1,6,9],[2,5,8]]

theorem allowed_support (S : List ℕ) (big : 2≤S.length)
    (ordered : S.Pairwise (fun i j => i+3≤j))
    (pos : ∀ k∈S,1≤k ∧ k≤9)
    (orient : ∀ k∈S,S.headD 0+k≤10) : S∈supportRows := by
  rcases S with _|⟨i,S⟩
  · simp at big
  rcases S with _|⟨j,S⟩
  · simp at big
  have ir := pos i (by simp)
  have jr := pos j (by simp)
  have ij := (List.pairwise_cons.mp ordered).1 j (by simp)
  have ia := orient j (by simp)
  change i+j≤10 at ia
  rcases S with _|⟨k,S⟩
  · have e : i=1 ∧ j=4 ∨ i=1 ∧ j=5 ∨ i=1 ∧ j=6 ∨ i=1 ∧ j=7 ∨ i=1 ∧ j=8 ∨ i=1 ∧ j=9 ∨ i=2 ∧ j=5 ∨ i=2 ∧ j=6 ∨ i=2 ∧ j=7 ∨ i=2 ∧ j=8 ∨ i=3 ∧ j=6 ∨ i=3 ∧ j=7 := by omega
    rcases e with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩|⟨rfl,rfl⟩|⟨rfl,rfl⟩|⟨rfl,rfl⟩|⟨rfl,rfl⟩|⟨rfl,rfl⟩|⟨rfl,rfl⟩|⟨rfl,rfl⟩|⟨rfl,rfl⟩|⟨rfl,rfl⟩|⟨rfl,rfl⟩|⟨rfl,rfl⟩ <;> simp [supportRows]
  have kr := pos k (by simp)
  have jk := (List.pairwise_cons.mp (List.pairwise_cons.mp ordered).2).1 k (by simp)
  have ib := orient k (by simp)
  change i+k≤10 at ib
  rcases S with _|⟨l,S⟩
  · have e : i=1 ∧ j=4 ∧ k=7 ∨ i=1 ∧ j=4 ∧ k=8 ∨ i=1 ∧ j=4 ∧ k=9 ∨ i=1 ∧ j=5 ∧ k=8 ∨ i=1 ∧ j=5 ∧ k=9 ∨ i=1 ∧ j=6 ∧ k=9 ∨ i=2 ∧ j=5 ∧ k=8 := by omega
    rcases e with ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl⟩|⟨rfl,rfl,rfl⟩|⟨rfl,rfl,rfl⟩|⟨rfl,rfl,rfl⟩|⟨rfl,rfl,rfl⟩|⟨rfl,rfl,rfl⟩|⟨rfl,rfl,rfl⟩ <;> simp [supportRows]
  have lr := pos l (by simp)
  have kl := (List.pairwise_cons.mp (List.pairwise_cons.mp (List.pairwise_cons.mp ordered).2).2).1 l (by simp)
  omega

#print axioms allowed_support
